name: North Beach Bark Beach (Miami Beach)
address: Between 80 and 81 Streets, east of North Beach Oceanside Park; entrance at Collins Avenue and 81 Street, Miami Beach
hours: Friday, Saturday and Sunday only. March to October: 3 p.m. to 7 p.m. November to February: 1:30 p.m. to 5:30 p.m.
fee: No permit or fee stated on the official page. Metered public parking lot across from the site.
rules: The city's only designated beach area for dogs; dogs are prohibited from all other city beaches.

name: Haulover Park Dog Beach (Miami-Dade County)
address: Haulover Park, 10800 Collins Ave., between lifeguard towers 2 and 3; access via parking lots 3 and 4
hours: Daily, sunrise to sunset (official park page).
fee: Park parking: Monday to Thursday $7 per car; weekends and holidays $10 per car (park page). Parking lots open sunrise until one hour before sunset.
rules: Off leash only between towers 2 and 3, and only if the owner keeps control at all times; leash required everywhere else.
Limit of two dogs per person.
Puppies under 6 months are not permitted.
Scoop poop, fill holes, stop aggressive behavior or remove the dog.
flag: Conflict: the official park page says daily sunrise to sunset, while a local news item (Miami Laker, not official) describes a 'Dogs on the Dunes' schedule of Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays, 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. Call the park before going.

name: Dog Beach at Hollywood Beach
address: 4999 N Surf Rd, Hollywood, FL 33020, between the Pershing and Custer Street lifeguard stands
hours: Sunrise to sunset (official page; no day restriction stated).
fee: No passes required. Street parking.
rules: Owners are legally responsible for and must control their dogs at all times, and clean up waste.
Dogs must have a current rabies tag.
Dogs must be leashed anywhere outside Dog Beach.
Prohibited: sick dogs, dogs in heat, aggressive dogs, other animals.
Exit the beach immediately when lightning is seen or thunder heard.
phone: 954-921-3404 (City of Hollywood number as listed by Broward County)
flag: Older community guides describe weekend-only hours and a permit; the current official page says sunrise to sunset with no passes required.

name: Canine Beach (Fort Lauderdale)
address: Second set of parking spaces north of Sunrise Boulevard on A1A (approximately 1269 N. Fort Lauderdale Beach Blvd)
hours: 6 a.m. to 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. (official Dog-Friendly Places page).
fee: No permit or fee is stated on the official page we could read.
rules: Dogs only from lifeguard tower 16 to a point 100 yards north of Sunrise Boulevard (posted as Canine Beach).
Maximum of three dogs per owner or handler.
A1A dog walking (west side of A1A, Sunrise Blvd south to Seabreeze Blvd): 6 a.m. to 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. to 7 p.m.; west side of A1A north of Sunrise Blvd: 24 hours.
flag: Conflict and gap: the Canine Beach URL provided (fortlauderdale.gov .../beach-public-canine-beach) returned 404 on 21 Oct 2026; facts are from the city's Dog-Friendly Places page. Community sites (not official) still describe Friday to Sunday hours (3 p.m. to 7 p.m. November to March, 3 p.m. to 9 p.m. April to October) and a permit of $30 resident, $45 non-resident or $7 weekend. Confirm with Fort Lauderdale Parks before you go.

name: Wags and Waves Dog Beach (Pompano Beach)
address: SE 2nd Street Beach Access entrance, Pompano Beach
hours: Not stated on the official pages we could read.
fee: Not stated on the official pages we could read.
flag: Gap: the city's Dog Park and Beach page lists the location but no detail page for the dog beach was available on 21 Oct 2026. Call Parks and Recreation for days, hours and permit rules.

name: Bark Beach at Spanish River Park (Boca Raton)
address: 3001 N State Road A1A, Boca Raton, FL 33487, between lifeguard towers 18 and 20
hours: 7 days a week. 3 p.m. to sunset during Eastern Standard Time; 5 p.m. to sunset during Daylight Saving Time.
fee: Bark Beach Dog Entry Permit required (Oct 1 to Sep 30). Annual resident (City of Boca Raton and Greater Boca Raton Beach and Park District) $70; annual non-resident $630; three-day permit $20 per visit, used on three consecutive days. Fees per household as of October 1, 2026. Beach parking is not included. From October 1, 2026, gatehouses no longer accept cash.
rules: Carry the permit at all times; each dog needs its own permit; limit of two dogs per person.
Leash dogs when entering and leaving; off leash only in the dog area during Bark Beach hours.
Carry a waste disposal device; dogs must not dig.
No nuisance behavior such as excessive barking or aggression.

name: Jupiter Dog Beach
address: 2.5 miles from dune crossover marker 26 (north of Ocean Cay Park, 2188 Marcinski Road) north to marker 57 (south of Carlin Park, 400 S. S.R. A1A), Jupiter
hours: Sunrise to sunset.
fee: No permit stated. Parking is free.
rules: Off leash allowed for behaved, obedient, well-socialized dogs that respond to voice commands.
Leash dogs while walking from the car to the beach.
Dogs are not allowed in lifeguarded areas (service animals excepted), Palm Beach County natural areas or Town of Jupiter parks.
Dogs must wear tags and licenses and show evidence of rabies vaccination; owners remove waste.

name: Haulover Park Bark Park
address: Haulover Park, 10800 Collins Ave., near the south picnic area (entrance via lots 3 and 4)
hours: Sunrise to sunset, seven days a week.
fee: $5.47 per vehicle; the dog must be in the vehicle.
rules: Separate areas for dogs under 35 pounds and over 35 pounds.
County dog park rules: current rabies tag, limit 3 dogs per person, leash until inside the fence, no dogs in heat or with parasites, no aggressive dogs.

name: Barkham at Markham Park (Broward County)
address: 16001 W. State Rd. 84, Sunrise 33326
hours: Park's normal operating hours; closed every Tuesday morning until 10 a.m. for maintenance.
fee: Annual membership $25 (up to three dogs, one access card); daily fee $5 (up to three dogs); extra access card $15. Proof of current rabies vaccination with expiration or administered date required.
rules: Separate small dog (up to 25 pounds) and large dog areas.
Owners clean up after their pets.
flag: Seasonal: the county fee schedule says Barkham and Woofing Waters close from the third week of January through the second week of April for maintenance.

name: Woofing Waters at Quiet Waters Park (Broward County)
address: 401 S. Powerline Rd., Deerfield Beach 33442
hours: 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily; closes seasonally (third week of January through second week of April per the fee schedule).
fee: Same county membership: $25 annual or $5 daily (up to three dogs). Two-hour private rental $250.
rules: Separate large and small dog sections with water features and dog wash areas.
Proof of rabies vaccination required.

name: Holiday Park Dog Park (Fort Lauderdale)
address: Holiday Park, Fort Lauderdale (street address not given on the dog page)
hours: 7:30 a.m. to 7 p.m.; closed Monday and Wednesday, 8 a.m. to 11 a.m., for maintenance.
fee: Not stated.
rules: Current vaccination and license; no puppies under four months.
No more than three dogs per person; no digging; keep the gate closed.
No dogs in heat, ill or with parasites. Not staffed; use at your own risk.

name: Canine Corner Dog Park (Pompano Beach)
address: 1101 N. Federal Highway, Pompano Beach, FL 33062 (Federal Hwy and NE 10th Street)
hours: Daily 6:30 a.m. to 8:30 p.m.; closed Tuesdays for maintenance.
fee: Members only. Annual: resident $32 per dog ($10 each additional), non-resident $64 ($20). Six months: resident $22 ($10), non-resident $44 ($20). Weekly and daily options also offered. Register with proof of residency, rabies certificate (tag alone not enough) and a dog photo.
rules: Separate areas for dogs under 25 pounds and 25 pounds and over.
Maximum three dogs per adult; 6-foot leash, no retractable leashes; no spiked, choke or prong collars.
Current rabies tag and personalized ID tag on the collar; no infants, toddlers or strollers.

name: Canine Cove at Burt Aaronson South County Regional Park
address: 12551 Glades Road, west of Boca Raton
hours: Sunrise to sunset; closed every Wednesday 12 p.m. to 3 p.m. for maintenance.
fee: No fee stated on the county page.
rules: Palm Beach County dog park rules: limit 2 dogs per person, leash in hand at all times, dogs vaccinated and licensed, no food, no dogs in heat, under voice control.
Small dog area for dogs under 30 pounds.
